arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Calendar years 1969-1971 data (in millions of dollars)
# From Treasury Bulletin 1972

# 1969
redemptions_1969 = 76
sales_plus_discount_1969 = 366

# 1970
redemptions_1970 = 154
sales_plus_discount_1970 = 191

# 1971
redemptions_1971 = 124
sales_plus_discount_1971 = 27

# Calculate totals
total_redemptions = redemptions_1969 + redemptions_1970 + redemptions_1971
total_sales_plus_discount = sales_plus_discount_1969 + sales_plus_discount_1970 + sales_plus_discount_1971

print(f'Total Redemptions (1969-1971): {total_redemptions}')
print(f'Total Sales plus accrued discount (1969-1971): {total_sales_plus_discount}')

ratio = total_redemptions / total_sales_plus_discount
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')
print(f'Rounded to two decimal places: {round(ratio, 2)}')
"
